messages:
Lina: Quick question  friend visiting at 4pm with an electric scooter (foldable but battery pack attached). Also theres a framed print in Returns Shelf C3 marked only 'Marketing' but no name. Where's best to park the scooter and can MailOps hold the print? Also tiny seating poll: Sunny Couch by the windows or Conf Room A?
Diego (reception): We can pre-register and print a badge. For scooters, we prefer them off the main walkway  bike rack area inside west entrance usually works. If battery is removable we ask guests to take it with them; otherwise we move scooter to Secure Storage for safety.
Omar (mail): Framed print scanned at 3:02pm. Barcode read: "Marketing" but no owner. I can tag it "Marketing - unclaimed" and keep on Secure Shelf M1 for 72h. If not claimed we route to Marketing ops.
Kai: Sunny Couch is great for casual catchups, Conf Room A is better if you need plugs for a laptop. If scooter visitor needs a plug to top up battery, Conf Room A has a spare outlet.
Noah: For safety we should not charge guest batteries on office outlets unless the owner supervises. Facilities policy: removable battery OK to store, but charging requires owner. Happy to escort scooter to Secure Storage if needed.
FacilitiesBot: Safety checklist reminder: battery-powered devices should be declared at reception. If Secure Storage is used, complete the "Battery Device" form in #safety-ops. (automated)
Lina: Thanks  scooter is foldable but battery attached. They said theyll bring it in and probably won't charge. Diego  please pre-print as "Lina guest" and note "scooter (battery attached)". Omar  thanks for tagging the print.
Diego (reception): Badge queued: "Lina guest - scooter (battery attached)". I'll add a red sticky. We'll direct them to the west bike rack; if they prefer indoors I can put it in Secure Storage and fill the battery form.
Omar (mail): Print moved to Secure Shelf M1 and labeled "Marketing - unclaimed". Photo uploaded to #people-ops with location.
Kai: Poll so far: Sunny Couch 1, Conf Room A 0. If no one objects I'll reserve Sunny Couch.
Noah: I'll stand by the west entrance at 3:58pm to help carry scooter if needed. Also leaving a note in the reception log about battery.
Lina: Perfect  Sunny Couch it is. Appreciate everyone coordinating so fast. :sparkles:
Diego (reception): Scooter parked by bike rack at 4:02pm, sticky attached. Guest checked in and enjoyed coffee. Leaving a short note in the visitor log.
Omar (mail): If Marketing doesn't claim the print by Thursday I'll open a ticket to DM their lead. For now it's safe on M1.
FacilitiesBot: AC adjusted +0.5C near Secure Storage for 15 minutes per fragility protocol (automated).
Lina: Closing loop  all good. Thanks team! :v:
